verdict.rationale: Warp explicitly documents right-clicking to 'Ask Warp AI' to explain any error in command output, including demystifying opaque errors and identifying missing dependencies, plus '#' AI command suggestions that can help form corrected commands. This directly matches the story of getting AI explanations and fixes for failed commands. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of this specific error-explanation flow (community evidence covers other AI features but not this specific one), and no detail on how 'suggested fixes' are surfaced beyond explanation.
